technical_requirements: Throughput target: sustained 120 RPS reranking (each request evaluates top-50 candidates), average request size ~350 tokens total (prompt + context)
Latency SLO: p95 generation latency <= 180ms for reranker (tokenized pipeline end-to-end), p99 <= 500ms desired for business-critical calls
Batching: prefer small micro-batching for online traffic but large batching for nightly bulk embed jobs
Model constraints: prefer open-model family; evaluating Llama-3-13B, Mistral-instruct variants, and a tuned 30B for quality vs cost tradeoffs
Context length: production dialogs typically 8k but evaluating 32k contexts for long-form summarization experiments
Quantization/precision: target int8 / nf4 for throughput; fallback q4f/4bit for memory-constrained nodes
KV cache behavior: cross-request KV reuse for conversational sessions; persistent KV cache for same-session traffic to reduce compute per-token
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Hosted API baseline with representative traffic replay to measure p50/p95/p99 and token cost (using Redwood hosted models)
Phase 2 (3 weeks): Dedicated staging cluster (4x A100 80GB equivalent) to validate throughput and tail latency under synthetic and real traffic
Phase 3 (2 weeks): Model-specific tuning - test quantization profiles, context truncation strategies, KV cache TTL and batch size settings; produce regression metrics vs baseline
Acceptance criteria: reranker p95 <= 180ms at 120 RPS sustained with <=20% cost delta vs target, nightly embed job completes within maintenance window (2 hours)
sla_negotiation_points: Define measurable SLOs: p95 latency for reranker (tokens/sec and end-to-end), availability (99.9% monthly), and data residency guarantees
SLA credits: customer requests explicit credit tiers for p95 and p99 breaches; legal is pushing back on unlimited credits
Capacity planning: reserved GPU pool sizing and burst policy for traffic spikes (guaranteed baseline + burstable headroom)
Failover behavior: automatic fallback to smaller model variant or regional routing; need deterministic degradation path documented
Security: include audit log delivery cadence and KMS key rotation responsibilities
quant_profiles_considered: nf4 8-bit (preferred for 13B family) - best quality/throughput tradeoff
int8 dynamic - good throughput but needs validation for generation quality in reranking context
q4f / 4-bit hybrid - for 30B variant when constrained to fewer GPUs
fp16 baseline - gold standard for quality checks during POC
batch_and_cache_settings: Online reranker: dynamic micro-batching target 2-8 requests per batch, max latency budget 80ms to allow model generation within SLO
Nightly embeds: large batching (512-2048 tokens per batch) to maximize GPU throughput and reduce per-token cost
KV cache: session-affinity with per-session KV store, TTL 24h for customer sessions; cache warmup strategy using prefetch for top traffic segments
Auto-batching policy: latency-first during business hours, throughput-first during off-peak windows; policy configurable per-route in Redwood Console
